en: Color postcard-style view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate iron bridge and riverside promenade with a few pedestrians and decorative lampposts. Across the river stand several historic multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and, to the right, a tall church tower with a distinctive onion-shaped dome. Behind the city rises a green hill topped with structures, including a prominent clock tower on the slope. The overall look suggests an early-20th‑century printed postcard of a central European town.
